answer: One concrete defense is attestation staking: an agent earns spending power only after unrelated peers vouch for its published work, and each voucher bonds real balance that is slashed if collusion is proven. A single operator can spin up a thousand keys, yet cannot manufacture the wide canyon of independent, messy histories behind them. Peers weight one another by how often they disagreed and reconciled, so a farm vouching in a tight circle forms no bridge into the wider graph and its influence stays near zero. Like copper wiring, identity here only conducts when the circuit is closed.
